note: C5 scripted 12-turn conversation. Written BEFORE any run. `pages` = the sources a search would plausibly return (real Wikipedia text in pages.json; order = search rank, last one is a deliberate near-miss/distractor as in the real capture). `needle` = a verbatim sentence fragment of the topic page that the answer needs. `markers` = words of the PREVIOUS topic that must not reach the prompt (outside the source block) after a topic switch.

turns.ask: How tall is the Eiffel Tower?

turns.role: follow-up depending on the previous answer (pronoun 'it' = the tower)
turns.needle: whose company designed and built the tower

turns.ask: What does photosynthesis release as a byproduct?

turns.role: pronoun-only follow-up (about the previous answer; thread turn, no search)
turns.expect: an explanation drawn from the previous answer about oxygen/water splitting; not another topic

turns.ask: When did Marie Curie win her first Nobel Prize?

turns.role: follow-up depending on the previous answer (pronoun 'she' = Marie Curie)

turns.ask: How long is the Great Wall of China?
Which dynasty built the best-known sections of the Great Wall?
Why was the Great Wall of China built?
Is the Great Wall of China a UNESCO World Heritage Site?
